localChanges: With ?interface=new, the game setup lays out the map, the difficulty and the Advanced settings as labelled fields, with a line saying what the chosen difficulty level is like, and units beside the Advanced fields (#750).

With ?interface=new, each seat has a Human / Computer switch, its civilization's colours beside its choice, and its leader filled in when the civilization has only one. With no human seat, the setup says you will watch the game.
With ?interface=new, Start stays in view at the foot of the game setup, and with many seats only the list of seats scrolls.
